Landing.heroTitle: One calm place for your kids' whole week
Landing.heroSubtitle: Track recurring activities like school, gym, and swimming alongside one-off events like birthday parties and doctor's appointments — then print a clear weekly view for yourself, a co-parent, or a nanny.
Landing.privacyTitle: Nothing about your family leaves your browser
Landing.privacyBody: There's no account to create and no server storing your data. Your plan — kids' names, activities, everything — lives only in this browser. Use "Save plan" any time to download a backup file, and "Load plan" to bring it back or move it to another device.
Landing.step1Body: Give each kid a name and a color so their activities are easy to tell apart at a glance.
Landing.step2Body: Add recurring activities (with an optional date range, like a school year) and one-off events like parties or appointments — assign each to one kid or several.
Landing.step3Body: Print a specific week or a dateless "typical week" template, laid out as a real calendar with a shared time axis and a column per kid.
Landing.step4Body: Download your plan as a file whenever you like — it's your backup, and the way to pick up where you left off on another browser or device.
Landing.illustrationCalendarAlt: A colorful weekly calendar with activities for two kids
Landing.illustrationPrintAlt: A printed weekly plan coming out as a PDF
Landing.footerOpenSource: My kiddo week is an open-source project — <repoLink>view it on GitHub</repoLink>.
Landing.footerIssues: Found a bug, or have an idea for a feature? <issuesLink>Open an issue</issuesLink>.
